whoIAm.text: I am a Product Manager in digital health at Twin Health. I build products that turn hours of manual clinical operations work into minutes, using workflow automation and an AI agent.

whoIAm.heading: What I own
whoIAm.text: I own the product roadmap for partner launches, growth and care-team tools. I have led 44 partner launches (34 in the US, 10 in India), taken a pre-enrolment mobile app, the India website and a partner-vendor referral ecosystem from 0-to-1, and grown top-of-funnel leads 20% with condition-specific landing pages.

whoIAm.heading: How I work
whoIAm.text: Partner launches are where product strategy, go-to-market strategy and stakeholder management meet. Each one needs requirements across the landing page, Salesforce, the clinical app and the member app, and cross-functional leadership with the sales, onboarding, diagnostics, inventory and care teams who use them. I use product analytics in Mixpanel to measure what we ship.

whoIAm.heading: How I got here
whoIAm.text: I started in public health research (MPH, Occupational and Environmental Health) and ran a randomised trial of LPG subsidies published in World Development Perspectives. I moved through research program management and operations into product, so I understand clinical workflows, evidence and the people who use the tools. That adds up to 8+ years across product, operations and clinical research.

whoIAm.heading: What I am looking for
whoIAm.text: I am open to conversations about Product Manager roles in digital health and healthcare technology.

bestAt.title: Partner launches
bestAt.text: End-to-end product requirements across landing pages, Salesforce, the clinical app and the member app, with API integrations and real-time coverage verification across payers.

bestAt.title: AI and workflow automation
bestAt.text: An AI agent that reads blood-draw PDFs and uploads the report, rule-based agents for member adherence and commitment tracking, automated account creation from Salesforce, and incident alerts that cut response time from 24–48 hours to 30 minutes.

bestAt.title: Operational products
bestAt.text: Dashboards and work queues that cut onboarding time per member from 45–50 to 22–30 minutes.

bestAt.title: 0-to-1 products
bestAt.text: A pre-enrolment mobile app, the India website and a partner-vendor referral ecosystem, each taken from 0-to-1.
